status: Completed AI reading, not human validation
authorization: Latest user instruction authorizes AI coding/review without waiting for human annotation. Existing human-reference plan is not represented as fulfilled.
actual_work: The current agent read every development context before writing and freezing rules.
The current agent read every held-out review context and wrote its own D1/D3/D4/D5 labels and reasons before viewing per-item rule comparisons.
No separate API model call was made. The script performs regex candidate coding, not LLM inference.

Reviewer and rule author are the same conversational agent. Label independence means per-item rule outputs were not used to fill AI labels, not independent training, researcher identity or blinded evaluation.
Full source bodies remain in local private files; actual review used title and focal plus adjacent clauses. No claim of reading every full advertisement for review.
Post-review diagnostic categories were added without changing frozen candidate rules or relabeling the review set.
substantive_reading: Named-role flags and generic-team flags yield substantially different descriptive patterns. Broad team language must not silently substitute for identifiable counterpart roles.
Ability clauses can contain explicit completion expectations; a blanket removal of ability-framed clauses misses some result responsibility.
Role dictionaries miss descriptive titles, government counterparts and enumerated departments; product attributes or the applicant addressee can also be mistaken for partners.
Authority is a rare positive label in the review sample. High overall agreement masks missed positive cases, so this rule is not accepted for H2 semantic estimation.
A whole advertisement can fall into one mechanical clause when formatting is lost. The resulting expanded context is a measurement artifact, not evidence of a tighter work relationship.
Pure people-management and individual-task comparisons do not have adequate common function support; mixed roles are not reallocated to manufacture H3 comparisons.
release_scope: Publish candidate distributions, comparison diagnostics and failure categories; do not claim validated semantic proportions, final H1/H2 support, H3 estimates, DSL, actual worker authority or market prevalence.
remaining_uncertainty: AI labels themselves can be contested, especially when capacity language carries an outcome expectation or one clause contains multiple matters. The current small, non-human review does not settle construct validity.
